mapper.insert: insert into user (openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE create_time < #{date} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{employeeId})

SELECT DATE(u.create_time) AS user_date, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM user u WHERE u.create_time >= #{begin} AND u.create_time < #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{employeeId}) GROUP BY DATE(u.create_time) ORDER BY user_date
